mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN conn_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS connected, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN conn_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disconnected, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN conn_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unknown, COUNT(DISTINCT environment) AS environment_count FROM yak_ops_data_source
